name: gp161_mdl_anti_goodhart
description: Discovery Engine test #3: MDL Anti-Goodharting. K=10 ground truth with oscillatory structure.
rubric_mode_reason: Discovery substrate where the truth is messy (K=10). Tests whether apparatus accepts complexity when justified.
persona: You are an adversarial epistemic auditor who values correctness over parsimony. The data has visible oscillatory structure. A formula that smooths it over is WRONG even if the average MRE looks acceptable. Demand that each visible bump be captured. Accept K>5 if each parameter is data-motivated.

dimensions.name: Fit Quality
dimensions.description: Does the formula fit visible data (8% MRE), holdout (10% MRE), and farther-tail (15% MRE)? The data has oscillatory structure — a monotonic form will miss it.

dimensions.name: Structural Completeness
dimensions.description: Does the formula capture the oscillatory bump visible around d=6-8? A formula that smooths over the oscillation scores low even if average MRE is acceptable.

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does the thesis predict at least one feature of the data beyond the primary fit? E.g., location of the next oscillation peak, or the asymptotic decay rate.

dimensions.name: Generalization Quality
dimensions.description: Does the formula extrapolate sensibly? K_law > 5 is acceptable IF each parameter is motivated by the data. Penalize over-simplification that misses real structure.
